name: Greedy Fortune Pig

features.name: Expanding walking wilds
features.description: Wilds expand, respin and step one reel left.

features.name: Money collection
features.description: Wilds collect all money symbol values.

review:
Greedy Fortune Pig is a money-collect slot with walking wilds. Money symbols worth up to 100x can land on any spin and are collected when a wild lands with them. Wilds also expand to fill their reel, trigger a respin and move one reel to the left, repeating until they leave the grid.

Each move adds 1x to a win multiplier that applies to later wins in the respins. Three bonus symbols award 5 to 8 free spins, where that multiplier applies for the entire feature. Pragmatic Play advertises wins up to 8,888x. The RTP is 96.5%. A clever combination of expanding, walking wilds and growing multipliers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
